title: The normalized completed-to-native proper scalar mate on bounded-below complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and normalized native inverse-image data NativeRings [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data]. Let $E$ be a finite unlifted coefficient index in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $a$ be a compatible Change from the completed integral coefficient family of $E$ to the native locally finite coefficient family [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Assume that for every scheme $T$ and every normalized CoefficientPresentation $C$ at this index, $a.map(T)=C.integralMap$ [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. For any proper morphism of schemes $g:U\to V$ and any ambient derived module $M$ over the completed integral ring on $U$ that is bounded below for the standard t-structure, the actual component $(properComparison(a,g))_M$ is invertible. Here properComparison is the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of the canonical restriction/direct-image square [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. No constructibility, completeness or Tor condition on $M$, and no field of definition or absolute separatedness of the schemes, is imposed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; proper factors in the original scalar-mate plan steps 3–4; Hemo–Richarz–Scholbach, Lemma 5.3(1).

proof.text: Apply the restricted proper scalar-mate comparison to obtain an isomorphism after derived restriction along a.map V.
Restriction of scalars is exact and conservative. Its derived functor reflects isomorphisms by the homology criterion, so the original properComparison component is invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem native_proper_scalar_mate_bounded_below
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [N : NativeRings.{u} l]
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
      (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (ha : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u})
      (C : CoefficientPresentation l T (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) (embedding l E)),
      a.map T = C.integralMap l T)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V) [IsProper g]
    (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U
      ((PurCompactSupport.completed l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring U)))
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus M) :
    IsIso ((PurCompactSupport.properComparison a g).app M)
